title: Webb County Community Action Agency opens Christmas light assistance early, with applications Nov. 30
excerpt: Webb County Community Action Agency is starting its Christmas light assistance early this year, with applications available Nov. 30 and due Dec. 1-2 at five locations across the county.
content:
The Webb County Community Action Agency is bringing its light assistance program early this Christmas season, so families who need help paying their electric bill do not have to wait until January.

Applications for the light assistance program will be available Monday, Nov. 30, from 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., and completed applications can be turned in Tuesday, Dec. 1, and Wednesday, Dec. 2, from 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.

Applications will be available at five locations: the main CAA office at 111 Camino Nuevo Rd., Hwy. 359, Building B; the Fernando Salinas Community Center at 520 Reynolds St., second floor; the Lilia Perez Community Center at 4420 Old Santa Maria Rd.; the Larga Vista Community Center at 5401 Cisneros Dr.; and the Webb County Southern Public Health Facility at 1301 Paseo de los Santos Dr. in Laredo.

Each center will hand out 50 applications. Assistance is subject to eligibility requirements and program availability, and people who have already received assistance and do not meet the program requirements will not be eligible.

For more information, call (956) 523-4222.

Source: Webb County Community Action Agency, Nov. 23, 2026.
